name: Vaporize Blessing: Wild Waves
description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Hydro Dice and 2 Pyro Dice.
After you trigger Vaporize reaction(s): Heal the character on your team with the lowest HP for 1 HP, and causes that character to deal +1 DMG in the next instance. (Twice per round)
